instruction: Fix `is_number` so it recognises floats and negative numbers, not just all-digit strings.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/rpncalc.py b/rpncalc.py
--- a/rpncalc.py
+++ b/rpncalc.py
@@ -3,7 +3,11 @@
 
 def is_number(token):
     """Return True if ``token`` can be parsed as a number."""
-    return token.isdigit()
+    try:
+        float(token)
+        return True
+    except ValueError:
+        return False
